_about: The Black Market dealer's lines. Every entry becomes <file>_<take>.wav takes under tmp/black_market_vo/takes/ and the chosen take ships as sound_assets/tod/sfx/<file>.wav. 'wired' = the alias already exists and _tod_shop.gsc already plays it (drop-in by name). 'hook' = the trigger. Tags are ElevenLabs v3/v4 audio tags. ROUND 8 (user 2026-10-02: "redesign the black market dealer away from Richtofen ... He will be his own entity ... soft scary dark slightly cyber with occasional manic modes"): THE DEALER IS HIS OWN CHARACTER. No borrowed lore, no accent, no other character's cadence, no German, no name. 'egg' marks a line that hints at HIS OWN story: he was open before the city fell and will be open after; the tower takes and pays him; he keeps a ledger with every name in it; the sign in the sky is his; there is nothing under the mask but a bigger mask; he was the first customer and paid with his face; he keeps the ones who cross him; the voices in the walls are old customers; and the open account the player will settle at the bottom (the fight). 'mode': 'manic' marks the OCCASIONAL manic crack: generate.py renders those with the manic delivery (low stability, high style, faster), every other line soft and even. The sign laugh keeps its own settings. ROUND 7's class lines ('cls' = archer / breacher / warrior / necro; _tod_shop vo_cls plays them TOD_SPIN_VO_CLASS_PCT of the time) stay, re-voiced. Rounds 1-7 are history (docs/198).
